s0301.literal: On yimao day, surveillance censor Chen Liang impeached Eastern Zhejiang surveillance commissioner Tuotuo Chiyan for currying favor with the powerful minister Doresh; his birth mother Lady He had originally been his father's concubine, yet his elder brother married her, deceiving the court and securing enfeoffment as Lady of Wen State — dismissal from censorial office and recovery of conferred favors were requested as fitting.
s0301.idiomatic: On yimao day, surveillance censor Chen Liang impeached Eastern Zhejiang surveillance commissioner Tuotuo Chiyan for currying favor with the powerful minister Doresh; his birth mother Lady He had originally been his father's concubine, yet his elder brother married her, deceiving the court and securing enfeoffment as Lady of Wen State — dismissal from censorial office and recovery of conferred favors were requested as fitting.

s0302.literal: Censorate officials reported; it was approved.
s0302.idiomatic: Censorate officials reported; it was approved.

s0303.literal: The gate of Cao, wife of Hu De of the Dadu Right Patrol Office, was honored for chastity.
s0303.idiomatic: The gate of Cao, wife of Hu De of the Dadu Right Patrol Office, was honored for chastity.

s0304.literal: On renxu day, fifteen thousand ingots of notes relieved thirty thousand three hundred sixty-two households of Mongol famine refugees under King Doreji and nine other divisions.
s0304.idiomatic: On renxu day, 15,000 ingots of notes relieved 30,362 households of Mongol famine refugees under King Doreji and 9 other divisions.

s0305.literal: On guihai day, an edict: "Officials in active service or holding acting posts not yet installed who perform bribery and lobbying for others — if they took anything, officials are judged for bribery under the twelve articles and clerks are dismissed and never reappointed for life;
s0305.idiomatic: On guihai day, an edict: "Officials in active service or holding acting posts not yet installed who perform bribery and lobbying for others — if they took anything, officials are judged for bribery under the 12 articles and clerks are dismissed and never reappointed for life;

s0306.literal: even if nothing was taken, if litigation arose and was suppressed through them, punishment is one degree above ordinary persons."
s0306.idiomatic: even if nothing was taken, if litigation arose and was suppressed through them, punishment is 1 degree above ordinary persons."

s0307.literal: On jiazi day, the Imperial Stores Directorate issued traveling-camp outfits to palace concubines, eunuchs, and garrison guardsmen.
s0307.idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Imperial Stores Directorate issued traveling-camp outfits to palace concubines, eunuchs, and garrison guardsmen.

s0308.literal: Garrison guardsmen of the Crane-Control Guard were exempted from serving as relay households.
s0308.idiomatic: Garrison guardsmen of the Crane-Control Guard were exempted from serving as relay households.

s0309.literal: On bingyin day, all campaign troops from Yunnan returned; Wusa Luoluo barbarians again killed garrison troops Huang Haichao and others, and Sajabo again killed and plundered good people in rebellion; an edict to Yunnan Branch Secretariat and Mobile Privy Council: "All border-post garrison troops must not be lightly withdrawn; urgency should govern how to control changes.
s0309.idiomatic: On bingyin day, all campaign troops from Yunnan returned; Wusa Luoluo barbarians again killed garrison troops Huang Haichao and others, and Sajabo again killed and plundered good people in rebellion; an edict to Yunnan Branch Secretariat and Mobile Privy Council: "All border-post garrison troops must not be lightly withdrawn; urgency should govern how to control changes.

s0310.literal: " On dingmao day, the moon infringed Bi; Venus infringed Jing.
s0310.idiomatic: " On dingmao day, the moon infringed Bi; Venus infringed Jing.

s0311.literal: On gengwu day, because last year's rain in Taixing and Jiangdu counties in Yangzhou harmed the grain, this year's rent was exempted.
s0311.idiomatic: On gengwu day, because last year's rain in Taixing and Jiangdu counties in Yangzhou harmed the grain, this year's rent was exempted.

s0312.literal: Privy Council officials said: "Seven hundred troops of the Campaign-West ten-thousand-household office, since Taiding, have repeatedly received favorable treatment; four hundred fifty were released home; now border garrisons are few — by precedent they should be compelled back to camp.
s0312.idiomatic: Privy Council officials said: "700 troops of the Campaign-West ten-thousand-household office, since Taiding, have repeatedly received favorable treatment; 450 were released home; now border garrisons are few — by precedent they should be compelled back to camp.

s0314.literal: This month, Jinning and Yijina routes had drought; Jining Route silkworms ate mulberry; subordinate counties of Henan and Jinning routes had locusts; subordinate prefectures and counties of Dadu, Baoding, Zhending, Hejian, and Dongchang routes and various colony fields had floodwater; the Zhang River in Linzhang County, Zhangde Route burst its banks.
s0314.idiomatic: This month, Jinning and Yijina routes had drought; Jining Route silkworms ate mulberry; subordinate counties of Henan and Jinning routes had locusts; subordinate prefectures and counties of Dadu, Baoding, Zhending, Hejian, and Dongchang routes and various colony fields had floodwater; the Zhang River in Linzhang County, Zhangde Route burst its banks.

s0315.literal: Seventh month, autumn, on jiaxu new moon, wintering guardsmen at Yemachuan and other places were granted clothing.
s0315.idiomatic: Seventh month, autumn, on jiaxu new moon, wintering guardsmen at Yemachuan and other places were granted clothing.

s0316.literal: Deputy director of the Arts and Literature Directorate Ouyang Xuan said: "The fifty-fourth-generation descendant enfeoffed Duke Yansheng, whose nobility is the lowest of five grades and whose rank is third grade, yet uses a fourth-grade copper seal — this does not match title and rank.
s0316.idiomatic: Deputy director of the Arts and Literature Directorate Ouyang Xuan said: "The 54th-generation descendant enfeoffed Duke Yansheng, whose nobility is the lowest of 5 grades and whose rank is 3rd grade, yet uses a 4th-grade copper seal — this does not match title and rank.

s0317.literal: " An edict ordered a junior third-grade seal cast and granted.
s0317.idiomatic: " An edict ordered a junior 3rd-grade seal cast and granted.

s0318.literal: Dean Prefecture had flood last year — this year's field rent was exempted.
s0318.idiomatic: Dean Prefecture had flood last year — this year's field rent was exempted.

s0319.literal: Gao Kechan of Yingshan County, Dean, was honored for filial conduct.
s0319.idiomatic: Gao Kechan of Yingshan County, Dean, was honored for filial conduct.

s0320.literal: On jimao day, because Yunnan was already pacified and only Luchu and others, fearing punishment, skulked in hiding, an edict granted them a conditional amnesty.
s0320.idiomatic: On jimao day, because Yunnan was already pacified and only Luchu and others, fearing punishment, skulked in hiding, an edict granted them a conditional amnesty.

s0321.literal: On xinsi day, Zhirha'der, whose crime merited exile to the frontier, was released because he was maternal nephew of Tangqishi.
s0321.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Zhirha'der, whose crime merited exile to the frontier, was released because he was maternal nephew of Tangqishi.

s0322.literal: On renwu day, portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to at the Hanlin National History Academy.
s0322.idiomatic: On renwu day, portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to at the Hanlin National History Academy.

s0323.literal: Surveillance censors Zhang Yi and others said: "In Emperor Yingzong's reign Qincha Tai secretly joined Palace Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Yaochu in plotting, falsely accusing Toghancha'er of intending a treasonous scheme; the charge implicated the hidden residence, causing exile to Hainan.
s0323.idiomatic: Surveillance censors Zhang Yi and others said: "In Emperor Yingzong's reign Qincha Tai secretly joined Palace Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Yaochu in plotting, falsely accusing Toghancha'er of intending a treasonous scheme; the charge implicated the hidden residence, causing exile to Hainan.

s0324.literal: At the start of Tianli, Doresh held Shangdu and dispatched Qincha Tai with troops to refuse orders; Doresh suspected disloyalty, seized him again and brought him back, then revived the old charge of Yaochu's plot to exculpate himself.
s0324.idiomatic: At the start of Tianli, Doresh held Shangdu and dispatched Qincha Tai with troops to refuse orders; Doresh suspected disloyalty, seized him again and brought him back, then revived the old charge of Yaochu's plot to exculpate himself.

s0325.literal: When the Emperor took the throne, he did not bear old grudges and promoted him to the Central Secretariat — yet he brought ruin on himself, leading to removal from office and registration of property.
s0325.idiomatic: When the Emperor took the throne, he did not bear old grudges and promoted him to the Central Secretariat — yet he brought ruin on himself, leading to removal from office and registration of property.

s0326.literal: Soon he was again pardoned and made Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor.
s0326.idiomatic: Soon he was again pardoned and made Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor.

s0327.literal: Now Yunnan is not pacified and borders Shu; this man is changeable and cannot be trusted — office should be stripped and he exiled far away, with household property still confiscated.
s0327.idiomatic: Now Yunnan is not pacified and borders Shu; this man is changeable and cannot be trusted — office should be stripped and he exiled far away, with household property still confiscated.

s0328.literal: " Censorate officials reported; an edict stripped his patent of appointment and gold tally; he and wife and children were confined in Guangdong, without registering his household.
s0328.idiomatic: " Censorate officials reported; an edict stripped his patent of appointment and gold tally; he and wife and children were confined in Guangdong, without registering his household.

s0329.literal: An edict also instructed censors: "For treacherous men like Qincha Tai, speak to the utmost — do not conceal."
s0329.idiomatic: An edict also instructed censors: "For treacherous men like Qincha Tai, speak to the utmost — do not conceal."

s0330.literal: " Temür Buhua resigned the censor-in-chief post — not permitted.
s0330.idiomatic: " Temür Buhua resigned the censor-in-chief post — not permitted.

s0331.literal: On yiyou day, envoys were dispatched to perform proxy sacrifice to the Celestial Consort Protect-the-State Shelter-the-People Broadly Relieve Blessings and Favor Clearly Manifest.
s0331.idiomatic: On yiyou day, envoys were dispatched to perform proxy sacrifice to the Celestial Consort Protect-the-State Shelter-the-People Broadly Relieve Blessings and Favor Clearly Manifest.

s0332.literal: Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Compassion and Loyalty Pavilion on Longevity Mountain in Dadu, beginning the eighth day of the eighth month until the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
s0332.idiomatic: Western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Compassion and Loyalty Pavilion on Longevity Mountain in Dadu, beginning the 8th day of the 8th month until the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

s0333.literal: On dinghai day, Hainan Li bandits rebelled; an edict ordered Jiangxi and Huguang provinces jointly to raise troops to capture them.
s0333.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Hainan Li bandits rebelled; an edict ordered Jiangxi and Huguang provinces jointly to raise troops to capture them.

s0334.literal: Princes Sosgiyar Ganbu and Hariman and imperial son-in-law Wanzhe Temür dispatched envoys presenting grape wine.
s0334.idiomatic: Princes Sosgiyar Ganbu and Hariman and imperial son-in-law Wanzhe Temür dispatched envoys presenting grape wine.

s0335.literal: On renchen day, privy council administrator Tobedai was made censor-in-chief.
s0335.idiomatic: On renchen day, privy council administrator Tobedai was made censor-in-chief.

s0336.literal: On guisi day, Chen and Xingguo routes — insects harmed the grain — this year's rent was exempted.
s0336.idiomatic: On guisi day, Chen and Xingguo routes — insects harmed the grain — this year's rent was exempted.

s0337.literal: On jiawu day, Guide Prefecture — rain harmed the grain — this year's rent was exempted.
s0337.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Guide Prefecture — rain harmed the grain — this year's rent was exempted.

s0338.literal: Guardsmen and Mongol households were given four months' grain.
s0338.idiomatic: Guardsmen and Mongol households were given 4 months' grain.

s0339.literal: On yiwei day, the Minzi Academy was established in Jinan.
s0339.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Minzi Academy was established in Jinan.

s0340.literal: Hangzhou suffered fire; one hundred ninety afflicted households were relieved.
s0340.idiomatic: Hangzhou suffered fire; 190 afflicted households were relieved.

s0341.literal: On dingyou day, one thousand Gansu troops and five hundred Sarayigur troops were transferred to guard Canbulang against the Tibetan tribes.
s0341.idiomatic: On dingyou day, 1,000 Gansu troops and 500 Sarayigur troops were transferred to guard Canbulang against the Tibetan tribes.

s0342.literal: On wuxu day, Bayan was enfeoffed Prince of Junning, granted a gold seal, and still held his former posts as Grand Preceptor and privy council administrator.
s0342.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Bayan was enfeoffed Prince of Junning, granted a gold seal, and still held his former posts as Grand Preceptor and privy council administrator.

s0343.literal: Gaoyou Prefecture — last year's flood disaster — this year's rent was exempted.
s0343.idiomatic: Gaoyou Prefecture — last year's flood disaster — this year's rent was exempted.

s0344.literal: Anji County, Huzhou — violent flood; one hundred ninety persons drowned; twenty ingots of notes per person for burial; survivors were given two months' relief grain.
s0344.idiomatic: Anji County, Huzhou — violent flood; 190 persons drowned; 20 ingots of notes per person for burial; survivors were given 2 months' relief grain.

s0345.literal: On gengzi day, Guangxi Yao bandits were pacified; Prince Yundus Temür was recalled.
s0345.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Guangxi Yao bandits were pacified; Prince Yundus Temür was recalled.

s0346.literal: On xinchou day, Tian Xianshiyong and others of twenty-one cave barbarian districts in Huaide Prefecture presented local products; more than eight hundred captured persons were returned to their families.
s0346.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Tian Xianshiyong and others of 21 cave barbarian districts in Huaide Prefecture presented local products; more than 800 captured persons were returned to their families.

s0347.literal: On guimao day, mobile privy council administrator Cheku Temür led troops against rebel barbarian Silkhamishi and executed more than seven hundred of his followers.
s0347.idiomatic: On guimao day, mobile privy council administrator Cheku Temür led troops against rebel barbarian Silkhamishi and executed more than 700 of his followers.

s0348.literal: This month, subordinate counties of Henan and Fengyuan had locusts; subordinate counties of Dadu, Hejian, and Hanyang had floodwater; subordinate counties of Jining had hail that harmed the grain; Luzhou had flood last year; Ningxia had frost disaster — all were exempted this year's field rent; two hundred ninety relay households of Mingsha and Lanshan in Ningxia, one thousand two hundred new army households of Dingxi, and one thousand three hundred civilian households of Yingli were each given one month's grain; nine hundred famine households of Longxing Route were also given one month's grain.
s0348.idiomatic: This month, subordinate counties of Henan and Fengyuan had locusts; subordinate counties of Dadu, Hejian, and Hanyang had floodwater; subordinate counties of Jining had hail that harmed the grain; Luzhou had flood last year; Ningxia had frost disaster — all were exempted this year's field rent; 290 relay households of Mingsha and Lanshan in Ningxia, 1,200 new army households of Dingxi, and 1,300 civilian households of Yingli were each given 1 month's grain; 900 famine households of Longxing Route were also given 1 month's grain.

s0349.literal: Badosa'er, wife of He Qian of Hezhong County, Daning — on her husband's death she buried herself with him; her gate was honored.
s0349.idiomatic: Badosa'er, wife of He Qian of Hezhong County, Daning — on her husband's death she buried herself with him; her gate was honored.

s0350.literal: Eighth month, on jiachen new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.
s0350.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jiachen new moon, there was an eclipse of the sun.

s0351.literal: Tuolian Hutulu was enfeoffed Prince Jinggong; Shalamdorji was enfeoffed Prince Yide — both were given gilded silver seals.
s0351.idiomatic: Tuolian Hutulu was enfeoffed Prince Jinggong; Shalamdorji was enfeoffed Prince Yide — both were given gilded silver seals.

s0352.literal: Western-region prince Busayin dispatched envoy Hudaduding to court.
s0352.idiomatic: Western-region prince Busayin dispatched envoy Hudaduding to court.

s0353.literal: Luanyang relay households — one horse and one ox each were added; market-purchase corvée and miscellaneous labor were exempted.
s0353.idiomatic: Luanyang relay households — 1 horse and 1 ox each were added; market-purchase corvée and miscellaneous labor were exempted.

s0354.literal: A stele for Shangdu's Confucius Temple was granted.
s0354.idiomatic: A stele for Shangdu's Confucius Temple was granted.

s0355.literal: Censorate officials impeached: "Palace Provision deputy commissioner Sangge, by recent imperial command to supply guardsmen's money and grain, delayed nine days, treated the law lightly and deceived the public — dismissal was fitting.
s0355.idiomatic: Censorate officials impeached: "Palace Provision deputy commissioner Sangge, by recent imperial command to supply guardsmen's money and grain, delayed 9 days, treated the law lightly and deceived the public — dismissal was fitting.

s0357.literal: On jiyou day, twenty-eight silver tallies were granted to Archery Guard company commanders; Yan Temür was ordered with ten thousand ingots to divide them among Mongol widows and orphans.
s0357.idiomatic: On jiyou day, 28 silver tallies were granted to Archery Guard company commanders; Yan Temür was ordered with 10,000 ingots to divide them among Mongol widows and orphans.

s0358.literal: On xinhai day, the grand carriage returned south to Dadu.
s0358.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the grand carriage returned south to Dadu.

s0359.literal: On renzi day, western-region prince Darimishi succeeded Dorjie Temür's position; Princes Borjijin Tai and others came to court with tribute.
s0359.idiomatic: On renzi day, western-region prince Darimishi succeeded Dorjie Temür's position; Princes Borjijin Tai and others came to court with tribute.

s0360.literal: On jiayin day, Yolqi Temür and Mielun Yisun, grandson of Xuebietai, presented falcons; they were granted one hundred taels of gold, one thousand five hundred taels of silver, five hundred ingots of notes, and one gold belt.
s0360.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Yolqi Temür and Mielun Yisun, grandson of Xuebietai, presented falcons; they were granted 100 taels of gold, 1,500 taels of silver, 500 ingots of notes, and 1 gold belt.

s0361.literal: The Tax Exaction Office was ordered not to collect commodity tax on commercial goods at Yan Temür's residence.
s0361.idiomatic: The Tax Exaction Office was ordered not to collect commodity tax on commercial goods at Yan Temür's residence.

s0362.literal: The Ordos region had suffered disaster years; much livestock died; seventeen thousand one hundred sixty households — the Inner Secretariat was ordered to give twenty thousand ingots for relief.
s0362.idiomatic: The Ordos region had suffered disaster years; much livestock died; 17,160 households — the Inner Secretariat was ordered to give 20,000 ingots for relief.

s0363.literal: On yimao day, Venus infringed the great star of Xuanyuan.
s0363.idiomatic: On yimao day, Venus infringed the great star of Xuanyuan.

s0364.literal: On bingchen day, inner scribe Qolaiqai was enfeoffed Duke of Feng State.
s0364.idiomatic: On bingchen day, inner scribe Qolaiqai was enfeoffed Duke of Feng State.

s0365.literal: Because of stellar anomalies, ministers were ordered to deliberate amnesty.
s0365.idiomatic: Because of stellar anomalies, ministers were ordered to deliberate amnesty.

s0366.literal: On dingsi day, Prince of Bin Buyan Temür was ordered to hunt at Fuzhou.
s0366.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Prince of Bin Buyan Temür was ordered to hunt at Fuzhou.

s0367.literal: On jiwei day, the Pacification Prince chief directorate was established at Fuzhou.
s0367.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Pacification Prince chief directorate was established at Fuzhou.

s0369.literal: Weishi County, Bianliang Route was granted to Bayan as enfeoffment fief.
s0369.idiomatic: Weishi County, Bianliang Route was granted to Bayan as enfeoffment fief.

s0370.literal: An edict ordered the Ministry of Justice to try inner attendant Saribuhua for witchcraft; all who merited death received one hundred seven strokes and exile to Guangdong and Guangxi.
s0370.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Ministry of Justice to try inner attendant Saribuhua for witchcraft; all who merited death received 107 strokes and exile to Guangdong and Guangxi.

s0371.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Next year's sea-transport grain is two million four hundred thousand shi — Jiang-Zhe has already been ordered to transport two million two hundred thousand and Henan two hundred thousand.
s0371.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said: "Next year's sea-transport grain is 2,400,000 shi — Jiang-Zhe has already been ordered to transport 2,200,000 and Henan 200,000.

s0372.literal: Now we request that Jiang-Zhe again increase by two hundred thousand — associate administrator Du Zhen is to supervise."
s0372.idiomatic: Now we request that Jiang-Zhe again increase by 200,000 — associate administrator Du Zhen is to supervise."

s0374.literal: Relief-sale of fifty thousand shi of rice was again ordered to aid the capital's poor.
s0374.idiomatic: Relief-sale of 50,000 shi of rice was again ordered to aid the capital's poor.

s0375.literal: Wei Duo of Jining Route was honored for filial conduct; Lady Wei, wife of Lu Tianlin of Yangzhou Route, was honored for chastity.
s0375.idiomatic: Wei Duo of Jining Route was honored for filial conduct; Lady Wei, wife of Lu Tianlin of Yangzhou Route, was honored for chastity.

s0376.literal: On gengshen day, Venus infringed the left horn of Xuanyuan.
s0376.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Venus infringed the left horn of Xuanyuan.

s0377.literal: Central Secretariat and Privy Council officials said: "Western-region prince Busayin — his minister Qolaimuding forged the prince's command to court; Busayin dispatched an envoy requesting he be arrested and returned.
s0377.idiomatic: Central Secretariat and Privy Council officials said: "Western-region prince Busayin — his minister Qolaimuding forged the prince's command to court; Busayin dispatched an envoy requesting he be arrested and returned.

s0378.literal: We deliberated: in a feudatory state's affairs, seizing envoys traveling back and forth and handing them over is impermissible; they should take the relay post home to justify themselves."
s0378.idiomatic: We deliberated: in a feudatory state's affairs, seizing envoys traveling back and forth and handing them over is impermissible; they should take the relay post home to justify themselves."

s0380.literal: On renshen day, the Palace Attendance Directorate rank was raised to 2a.
s0380.idiomatic: On renshen day, the Palace Attendance Directorate rank was raised to 2a.

s0381.literal: This month, Jiang-Zhe routes had floodwater that harmed grain — one hundred eighty-eight thousand seven hundred thirty-eight qing of fields were counted.
s0381.idiomatic: This month, Jiang-Zhe routes had floodwater that harmed grain — 188,738 qing of fields were counted.

s0382.literal: Jing Prefecture from the sixth month to this month had no rain.
s0382.idiomatic: Jing Prefecture from the 6th month to this month had no rain.

s0383.literal: Li and Si prefectures and other counties — last year's flood — this year's rent was exempted.
s0383.idiomatic: Li and Si prefectures and other counties — last year's flood — this year's rent was exempted.

s0384.literal: Yuan Prefecture had famine; two thousand shi of relief-sale rice was distributed.
s0384.idiomatic: Yuan Prefecture had famine; 2,000 shi of relief-sale rice was distributed.

s0385.literal: Jin and Xihe prefectures — successive years of drought disaster; the people were starving — they were relieved with five thousand ingots of Shaanxi salt-duty notes.
s0385.idiomatic: Jin and Xihe prefectures — successive years of drought disaster; the people were starving — they were relieved with 5,000 ingots of Shaanxi salt-duty notes.

s0386.literal: Ninth month, on guiyou new moon, Arluqun Sari's residence was purchased; Yan Temür was ordered to lodge Prince Guna Nadala there.
s0386.idiomatic: Ninth month, on guiyou new moon, Arluqun Sari's residence was purchased; Yan Temür was ordered to lodge Prince Guna Nadala there.

s0387.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "This year one hundred forty-eight thousand four hundred horses and camels should be fed; the capital feeds sixty thousand; the remainder are assigned to outer prefectures for divided feeding — each is given four ingots as fodder-and-grain price."
s0387.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials said: "This year 148,400 horses and camels should be fed; the capital feeds 60,000; the remainder are assigned to outer prefectures for divided feeding — each is given 4 ingots as fodder-and-grain price."

s0389.literal: On yihai day, the garrison command was ordered to mobilize soldiers to build a halting platform east of the Great Chengtian Huguo Temple.
s0389.idiomatic: On yihai day, the garrison command was ordered to mobilize soldiers to build a halting platform east of the Great Chengtian Huguo Temple.

s0390.literal: Censorate officials impeached: "Sichuan Branch Secretariat associate administrator Ma Yong — he issued six thousand shi of grain to supply the Yunnan army but turned back midway; he borrowed nineteen salary ingots in advance to take a concubine and also reviled grand councillor Wang Shouchang; though pardoned, he can hardly bear a chief ministerial post.
s0390.idiomatic: Censorate officials impeached: "Sichuan Branch Secretariat associate administrator Ma Yong — he issued 6,000 shi of grain to supply the Yunnan army but turned back midway; he borrowed 19 salary ingots in advance to take a concubine and also reviled grand councillor Wang Shouchang; though pardoned, he can hardly bear a chief ministerial post.

s0391.literal: " The Emperor said: "The norms of propriety and distinctions of noble and base — knowing nothing of them — how can one dwell above and oversee below!
s0391.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "The norms of propriety and distinctions of noble and base — knowing nothing of them — how can one dwell above and oversee below!

s0393.literal: " On bingzi day, Venus infringed Saturn.
s0393.idiomatic: " On bingzi day, Venus infringed Saturn.

s0394.literal: Privy Council officials said: "Dongchuan Route darughachi Puzhe'ernaju, joining Luchu's troops, killed Wusa Pacification Commissioner Yolqi and more than twenty of Dongchuan Route assistant prefect Jiaohuadu and others;
s0394.idiomatic: Privy Council officials said: "Dongchuan Route darughachi Puzhe'ernaju, joining Luchu's troops, killed Wusa Pacification Commissioner Yolqi and more than 20 of Dongchuan Route assistant prefect Jiaohuadu and others;

s0395.literal: again joining Boqu's nephew Afu, he led Mongol troops intending to strike Luoluo.
s0395.idiomatic: again joining Boqu's nephew Afu, he led Mongol troops intending to strike Luoluo.

s0396.literal: We deliberated with Yan Temür and dispatched Western Regions commander Suozhu and others to mobilize Shaanxi Metropolitan ten-thousand-household troops straight to Luoluo, mobilized Diaomen Pacification Commission troops, crossed the Great River, and went straight to Qiongbo Prefecture to patrol passes.
s0396.idiomatic: We deliberated with Yan Temür and dispatched Western Regions commander Suozhu and others to mobilize Shaanxi Metropolitan ten-thousand-household troops straight to Luoluo, mobilized Diaomen Pacification Commission troops, crossed the Great River, and went straight to Qiongbo Prefecture to patrol passes.

s0397.literal: " An edict also ordered the Xuanzheng Court to dispatch envoys jointly to supervise.
s0397.idiomatic: " An edict also ordered the Xuanzheng Court to dispatch envoys jointly to supervise.

s0398.literal: Hainan bandit Wang Zhou enticed nineteen cave Li barbarians, more than twenty thousand persons, into rebellion; Guangdong and Fujian troops were ordered transferred under Huguang Branch Secretariat left associate administrator Yila Sinu to command suppression and capture.
s0398.idiomatic: Hainan bandit Wang Zhou enticed 19 cave Li barbarians, more than 20,000 persons, into rebellion; Guangdong and Fujian troops were ordered transferred under Huguang Branch Secretariat left associate administrator Yila Sinu to command suppression and capture.

s0399.literal: New frontier garrisoners of Ashiq and Oros — Liaoyang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supply ox implements and provisions.
s0399.idiomatic: New frontier garrisoners of Ashiq and Oros — Liaoyang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supply ox implements and provisions.

s0400.literal: On jimao day, five thousand shi of grain was distributed to relieve the eagle factory of Xinghe Route.
s0400.idiomatic: On jimao day, 5,000 shi of grain was distributed to relieve the eagle factory of Xinghe Route.
